use_case: Water quality anomaly detection: a machine learning model flags unusual combinations of chlorine and chloramine residual, pH, turbidity, conductivity, flow, and pressure from Regional System plants and 14 distribution monitoring stations
vendor_or_model: Analytics vendor (multivariate time-series anomaly detection model) running as a pinned container in the cloud workloads account
build_or_buy: Buy (configured and baselined on 12 months of Regional historian data)
data_categories: Process and water quality data from the historian replica; no personal information
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: 171,400 people served by the Regional System, through operator decisions)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only. Alerts go to the ROC and the Water Quality and Compliance Manager; an operator confirms with a grab sample or second instrument before any process change or notice decision. No write path to SCADA; never suppresses SCADA alarms
applicable_laws: SDWA section 1433: RRA monitoring practices and ERP detection strategies (42 U.S.C. 300i-2(a)(1)(A)(iii), (b)(4)); 40 CFR Part 141 monitoring and public notice duties unchanged; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor accuracy claims)
status: In production as advisory since 2026-01 (Regional only); production reliance not approved until validation conditions are met

use_case: Chemical dose recommender (pilot): recommends sodium hydroxide and sodium hypochlorite doses for post-treatment at WTP-R2 from flow, pH, residual, and temperature trends; shown on a screen beside the HMI
vendor_or_model: Analytics vendor (supervised regression model) in the cloud workloads account
data_categories: Process data from the historian replica; no personal information
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: water reaching customers of the Regional System)
human_in_the_loop: Chief Operator on shift reviews each recommendation and enters any change at the HMI; hardwired stroke limits stay in force; no write path to SCADA (vendor request refused, P04)
applicable_laws: SDWA section 1433 (chemical handling and automated systems, 42 U.S.C. 300i-2(a)(1)(A)(ii), (v)); 40 CFR Part 141 treatment and monitoring duties unchanged; FTC Act Section 5
status: Pilot at WTP-R2 since 2026-06; continued pilot with conditions

use_case: AMI leak analytics: the AMI vendor's analytics flag continuous flow or unusual usage and send customers a leak alert
data_categories: Hourly interval usage by account; customer contact details
human_in_the_loop: Alerts are informational; no automatic shutoff, fee, or billing adjustment. Leak adjustments under the tariff are decided by customer service staff
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (customer data at the vendor); FTC Act Section 5 (accuracy of customer-facing claims)

use_case: Contact center virtual agent and call summaries: answers balance, outage, and notice questions by voice and chat, hands off to agents, and drafts call summaries in the CIS
vendor_or_model: CIS vendor feature (generative large language model; model provider carved out)
data_categories: Caller voice and transcripts; account number, service address, balance; call summaries (customer personal information)
affects_individuals: Yes (callers for 107,800 own accounts and 15,600 client accounts)
consequential_decision_category: None (re-tier to High if it ever decides payment arrangements, disconnections, or adjustments)
human_in_the_loop: Agent cannot change payment details, arrangements, or service status; staff review summaries before they are saved; callers can reach a person at any time
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) (calls recorded only with prior consent of all parties: recording announcement at call start); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); FTC Act Section 5; Utility Services agreements (client customers)

use_case: Main-break likelihood model: scores each pipe segment by break likelihood to rank replacement candidates in the capital plan
vendor_or_model: GIS and asset management vendor feature (gradient-boosted model)
data_categories: Pipe material, age, diameter, soil, pressure, and break history from GIS and work orders; no personal information
affects_individuals: Indirectly (neighborhoods whose mains are replaced sooner or later)
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review every ranked list; the model is one input to the capital plan approved by the COO
applicable_laws: SDWA section 1433 (capital needs, 42 U.S.C. 300i-2(a)(1)(B)); state utility regulator rate filings (out of scope)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant in the productivity suite: drafts documents, summarizes meetings and files, and answers questions from files the user can access
business_owner: Chief Operating Officer (sponsor) with the IT Director
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite provider (generative large language model under enterprise terms)
data_categories: Any file or message the user can access, including Restricted RRA and ERP content and customer correspondence
human_in_the_loop: Users review all output; no automated actions
applicable_laws: 42 U.S.C. 300i-2(d) and company protection of RRA and ERP content (POL-04); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) if customer data is processed
status: Enabled for 120 users since 2026-05; expansion paused until conditions are met
